description: Full-height (min-block-size) flex column that vertically centers a principal element (data-layout-principal; a sole child auto-centers), with header/footer or cover-top/-bottom children pinned to the edges. Attribute form: data-layout="cover".

attributes.name: data-layout-min
attributes.description: Minimum block size: 50 / 70 / 80vh, xl = 100dvh, auto = none. One-off: style="--layout-min: 65vh" (beats the token; registered inherits:false so it never reaches nested layouts; layout-grid reads the same property as its minimum column width).

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Minimum space between all children (top, principal, bottom), on the shared size scale. The principal's auto margins still centre it.

attributes.name: data-layout-centered
attributes.description: Center the principal and text horizontally; header/footer (and data-layout-cover-top/-bottom) children still span the full width.

childAttributes.name: data-layout-principal
childAttributes.description: The vertically centered principal element. A sole child auto-centers without it.

childAttributes.name: data-layout-cover-top
childAttributes.description: Pin to the top (a <header> child is pinned automatically).

childAttributes.name: data-layout-cover-bottom
childAttributes.description: Pin to the bottom (a <footer> child is pinned automatically).

childAttributes.name: data-container
childAttributes.description: With data-layout-centered, the layout removes container-type from semantic children so they size to their content instead of collapsing; this opts one back into container queries.
